about_the_game:
"Ichihime," the beloved mascot of the mahjong game Mahjong Soul, makes her debut as "Chibi Ichihime," a special deformed version exclusive to Desktop Mate. Retaining her iconic cat ears and charming habit of ending sentences with "nya," she now graces your desktop in a mini size. In addition to a variety of movements and expressions on Desktop Mate, she also comes with voice functionality.

An Innovative Link with Mahjong Soul

When you activate the Mahjong Soul link function, Chibi Ichihime will react to the Mahjong Soul game (Win Client, Steam version and Web version), watching the screen as if she's a spectator. During a match, she will display a range of expressive reactions at specific moments.

Important Notes

  • The linking function with Mahjong Soul is only compatible with the collaboration character "Mahjong Soul Chibi Ichihime." It will not work with other Desktop Mate characters.

  • Due to production constraints, this feature links by capturing the screen of "Mahjong Soul." For security, we do not save any captured images, and the system is designed not to capture any windows other than the "Mahjong Soul" window.

  • The linking function may not operate correctly depending on your PC's specifications and environment.

  • This function was planned specifically for this collaboration campaign and is not guaranteed to be permanently available. Additionally, updates to Mahjong Soul may temporarily make the linking function unavailable. Please be aware of this before use.

  • Note: To use this content, you must have Desktop Mate. Please update to the latest version.

  • Note: Please use this content in accordance with the "Guidelines for Fan Works, Game Streaming, and Video Posting" on the official Mahjong Soul website.

  • Note: You may use this content for streaming on platforms such as YouTube, Niconico Douga, and Twitch, provided you adhere to the above license.
